name: driving-and-geofencing-static-vanilla-js
description: Field Workforce Geofenced Attendance & Site Audit Router built with Static HTML, Vanilla JavaScript (ES Modules), Google Maps Platform, and Terra Draw.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs'])if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing '+f);console.log('Build verification passed.');})"
